description: Per source species: lncRNA transcripts donated (kept) and the four reasons the rest were dropped — no consistent strand ("?" or trans-spliced across both strands; almost always zero), single-exon (FOMO transfers spliced models only), not the longest spliced isoform of its gene (one transcript per gene; zero with --longest_isoform false) and coding potential (a complete ORF with PSAURON score at or above the cutoff). Bars sum to the raw lncRNA count.
